signals.summary: The at-home recovery sanctuary: saunas, cold plunges and vibration plates turning garages and spare rooms into private recovery rituals.
signals.why_now: Business Insider garage sauna+cold-plunge build at 52h; Breaking Muscle outdoor-sauna roundup and Women's Health vibration-plate 'trending' piece; Fitt Insider recovery-program launch and Ohio State athlete-recovery science echo the same recovery-first framing across 4+ independent outlets.

signals.summary: Mobility and longevity movement: gentle daily joint-mobility routines and morning stretch rituals framed as the way to stay strong and independent.
signals.why_now: Woman & Home 'Dr Amir Khan's 3 mobility exercises' at 2.9h is fresh; sustained by SELF '14 mobility moves over 35', FT 'mobility is this year's fitness tip', Joe Wicks morning-mobility routine and Katie Couric 'strong, steady, independent' — 5+ independent outlets on the same daily-mobility theme.

signals.summary: The 'do less' movement: intuitive, low-intensity, Zone-0 workouts and gentle group fitness replacing high-burn cardio as the aspirational mode.
signals.why_now: wionews 'Intuitive Workouts Take Over' at ~95h plus a steady drumbeat: ELLE 'case for doing less', WSJ 'workout that's almost nothing', NY Post 'Zone 0', Men's Journal 'forget cardio' shift, and ScienceAlert '30 minutes improves sleep' — 5+ independent outlets converging on softer movement.

signals.summary: Morning-light and pre-sleep movement rituals: grounding morning yoga, legs-up-the-wall and Tai Chi framed as bookends of the day on a mat in a quiet room.
signals.why_now: Yoga With Adriene 'Start the Day Grounded' and 'Legs Up The Wall for Better Sleep' flows recur alongside Sacramento Bee's Tai-Chi-for-sleep explainer and ScienceAlert's exercise-improves-sleep piece — a cross-source restorative-ritual cluster, though carried partly by one channel so velocity is modest.

signals.summary: Functional fitness racing goes mainstream: Hyrox/DEKA-style hybrid competitions with sleds, sandbags and wall balls as a spectator-scale movement.
signals.why_now: Trend Hunter's record-breaking DEKA Chicago event at 6.1h is the fresh hook; reinforced by USA Today 'Is Hyrox the new CrossFit?' and DMARGE on Nike's dedicated shoe system for 'the fitness trend taking over the world' — 3 independent outlets on hybrid-race fitness.

signals.summary: National Wellness Month (August): 'movement for mood' community initiatives and outdoor group activity framed as a late-summer wellness reset.
signals.why_now: Peaks now in-season: Chinook Observer on NIFS 'Move Your Mood' movement initiative (43h), thesunpapers senior-living workout-logging event (44h) and Ponca City's National Wellness Month feature (74h) — 3 independent local/trade outlets, all within the current August window.
